description: Defines Bluetooth GATT socket and attribute classes, including Attribute management, GATTSocket communication, and internal command handling for Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) operations.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth GATT attribute with serialization/deserialization and type handling.

classes.name: GATTSocket
classes.description: Manages BLE GATT socket communication, including command execution, notifications, and MTU management.

classes.name: GATTSocket::Command
classes.description: Encapsulates BLE GATT commands with serialization, deserialization, and response handling.

classes.name: GATTSocket::Response
classes.description: Stores and manages responses from BLE GATT operations, including attribute data and error handling.

methods.name: Attribute::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes attribute data from a byte stream.

methods.name: GATTSocket::Security
methods.description: Sets security level for BLE connection.

methods.name: GATTSocket::Execute
methods.description: Executes a BLE command with optional callback handler.

methods.name: GATTSocket::Notification
methods.description: Handles incoming BLE notifications (virtual, to be implemented).

methods.name: GATTSocket::Operational
methods.description: Handles operational state changes (virtual, to be implemented).
